Positive local query reads RoPE/indices/attention/inverse rotation. Zero query still preprocesses global cache, emits zero-length head tensor, then CP pads/exchanges/restores caller suffix and invokes O projection. Never early-return the whole layer just from local query0.

worker_source_leg_review.constraint: Normal entry requires no pending ExecuteModelState; pending raises before input mutation. sample_tokens unpacks and clears it before sampler/drafter.
Nested prepare scope and CPU-copy lease: prior-copy event wait before reused CPU writes, record in finally including early return/errors.

Zero scheduler total returns EMPTY or transfer-no-forward; external-launcher DP branch calls dummy first. Different from active frame with zero local CP query.
External launcher branch is reviewed as counterfactual until resolved executor class; no assertion from absent CLI alone.
Even positive scheduler total may have empty/zero effective batch after updates; guard returns before input/metadata/model.
Cascade flag/DBO gate and helper call remain conditional; backend capability/prefix outcome separate, no assume prefix caching means cascade.
Debug logging read-only branch; no tensor/numerical change assumed.
Batch descriptor may carry padded num_reqs or None; retain actual count fallback.
